title: Mieruko-chan
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Miko suddenly starts seeing grotesque ghosts and spirits everywhere. Rather than react, she pretends not to see them so they will leave her alone, mixing horror with deadpan comedy as she protects her friends and encounters shrine spirits and stronger entities (to verify).
life_message: It holds up quiet courage, composure under fear and protecting friends.

content.note: Monsters menace but little direct violence (to verify).
